title: Dashboard
body:
**Blueprint Designs** builds custom work for Roblox and Discord. Liveries, uniforms, ELS, graphics, bots, sites.

Everything you need is below. Head to the order channel to buy, or open a ticket if you're stuck.

options.label: Terms of Service
options.description: What you agree to when you order
options.title: Terms of Service
options.content:
**Payment**
Paid up front unless staff agree otherwise in writing. We use gamepasses. Never send Robux to anyone claiming to be staff in DMs.

**Revisions**
Reasonable changes are free. Redesigning from scratch after approval is a new order.

**Ownership**
The work is yours once it's paid for. We keep the right to show it in our portfolio unless you ask us not to.

**Conduct**
Be civil with the designers. Abuse gets your order cancelled without a refund.

options.label: Refunds
options.description: When you get your Robux back
options.title: Refunds
options.content:
**You get a refund if**
Work hasn't started yet, we can't deliver what was agreed, or what you got is clearly not what you asked for.

**You don't if**
The work was delivered and approved, or you changed your mind after we started.

Open a ticket and say what happened. Include your order number.

options.label: Server Rules
options.title: Server Rules
options.content:
**1.** Follow Discord's ToS and Community Guidelines.
**2.** No harassment, slurs, or drama.
**3.** No advertising or DM ads.
**4.** Use channels for what they're for.
**5.** No alt accounts to dodge punishments.

Staff calls are final in the moment. Appeal in a ticket, not in chat.

options.label: How Ordering Works
options.title: How Ordering Works
options.content:
**1.** Open a ticket from the order panel and pick your service.
**2.** Fill in the form. Vague briefs get vague results.
**3.** A designer claims it and quotes you.
**4.** Pay via the gamepass we send.
**5.** Get your work, ask for changes if needed.
**6.** Leave a review. It actually helps us.
